items.title: 27.3.2 Enzyme catalysed reactions mein inhibitors ka role (kirdar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of enzyme inhibitors with Quick Check 27.3 answered (PDF 168-169).

blocks.text: Woh chhote molecules ya ions jo enzymes ki catalytic activity khatam kar dein inhibitors (enzyme ko rokne wale) kehlate hain. Mukhtalif inhibitors mukhtalif tareeqe se kaam karte hain, lekin sab active site ko substrate se jurne se rok dete hain.

Reversible inhibitors ko competitive inhibitors bhi kehte hain, kyun ke in ki shakal substrate jaisi hoti hai. Substrate aur inhibitor dono enzyme ki active site ke liye compete (muqabla) karte hain. Inhibitor jitna zyada hoga, enzyme asal substrate ke liye utna hi kam kaam karega. Maslan substrate butanedioate (succinate ion) ko enzyme succinate dehydrogenase oxidise karta hai. Propanedioate ion (malonate) succinate se milta julta hai, is liye yeh is enzyme ko rok deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab enzyme ka naam 'dehydrogenase succinate' likhti hai; sahi naam succinate dehydrogenase hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Dono ions ke dono ends (siron) par COO⁻ group hai; farq sirf beech ke CH₂ groups ka hai (succinate mein do, malonate mein aik). Isi milti julti shakal ki wajah se malonate active site mein baith jata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: active site wala enzyme aur us ki taraf jata substrate S. Milti julti shakal ka inhibitor I dala jata hai aur teer enzyme-inhibitor complex tak jata hai: inhibitor active site mein non-covalent bond se baitha hai aur substrate S bahar reh jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.8: Reversible inhibitor ka action (kaam) (kitab ki Figure 27.8 ke mutabiq hamari drawing; bond ka label theek kiya gaya).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Inhibitor I ki shakal substrate jaisi hai, is liye woh active site mein baith jata hai aur substrate S ki jagah le leta hai. Yeh kamzor non-covalent forces se jurta hai, is liye alag bhi ho sakta hai; isi liye isay reversible kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Figure 27.8 mein kitab ne reversible inhibitor ke jor par 'Covalent Bond' likha hai. Reversible (competitive) inhibitor kamzor non-covalent forces se jurta hai aur alag ho sakta hai; covalent bond hota to inhibition irreversible ho jati. Is liye hamari drawing mein 'Non-covalent bond' likha gaya hai.

Non-competitive inhibitors, jinhein kitab irreversible kehti hai, chhote ions ya molecules hain jo active site ki shakal hi badal dete hain, is liye woh substrate ke liye available (dastiyab) nahi rehti. Aisi inhibition (rokawat) wapas nahi hoti (irreversible) aur kabhi kabhi sehat ke serious (sangeen) masail ya maut ki wajah banti hai. Jis enzyme se irreversible inhibitor, jaise zehr (poisons), antibiotics, anti-metabolites aur kuch dawaiyan, jur jaye woh hamesha ke liye apni activity kho deta hai (Figure 27.9).

blocks.alt: Do peele enzymes. Pehle mein hara substrate active site mein theek baithta hai. Doosre mein laal non-competitive inhibitor enzyme ke side par kisi aur jagah jura hai; active site ki shakal badal gayi hai aur substrate ab fit nahi hota.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.9: Non-competitive inhibitor ka action (kaam) (kitab ki Figure 27.9 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Non-competitive inhibitor active site par nahi, enzyme ki kisi aur jagah jurta hai. Is se enzyme ki shakal badalti hai aur active site bigar jati hai, is liye substrate ab us mein fit nahi hota, chahe substrate kitna hi zyada ho.

Penicillin aik irreversible inhibitor hai jo enzyme transpeptidase ko rok deti hai. Bacteria yeh enzyme apni cell wall banane ke liye use karte hain. Is tarah penicillin cell wall wale enzyme ko bigar kar bacteria ko maar deti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab aakhri jumle mein likhti hai 'Thus insulin kills bacteria'. Bacteria ko insulin nahi, penicillin maarti hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Enzymes inorganic catalysts se kaise mukhtalif hain?
blocks.explanation: Enzymes proteins hain; yeh bohat specific (aik substrate), bohat tez, aur narm halaat (taqreeban 37 °C, taqreeban neutral pH) mein kaam karte hain, aur garmi ya ghalat pH se denature ho jate hain. Inorganic catalysts kam specific hote hain, aksar zyada temperature chahte hain aur denature nahi hote.

rows: Proteins hain
Saada inorganic maadde (metals, metal oxides waghera) hain
Bohat specific: aksar sirf aik substrate par kaam
Kam specific: kai reactions tez kar sakte hain
Bohat tez kaam karte hain
Aam tor par is se kam tez
Narm halaat mein kaam: taqreeban 37 °C aur taqreeban neutral pH
Aksar zyada temperature ya pressure chahiye
Garmi ya ghalat pH se denature ho jate hain
Denature nahi hote

blocks.prompt: b) Temperature kam karne aur barhane ka enzyme ki activity par kya asar hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Temperature kam karne se reaction sust hota hai (kam aur halki takkarein) magar enzyme kharab nahi hota. Barhane se optimum tak activity barhti hai; us se oopar enzyme denature ho jata hai aur activity tezi se girti hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Competitive aur non-competitive inhibitors mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Competitive inhibitor substrate jaisa hota hai aur active site se wapas hone wale (reversible) tareeqe se jurta hai; zyada substrate dal kar is ka asar kam kiya ja sakta hai. Non-competitive inhibitor kisi aur jagah jur kar active site ki shakal badal deta hai; zyada substrate se is ka asar khatam nahi hota (kitab inhein irreversible kehti hai).

rows: Shakal substrate jaisi hoti hai
Shakal substrate jaisi hona zaroori nahi
Active site par hi jurta hai
Enzyme ki kisi aur jagah jurta hai
Active site ke liye substrate se compete karta hai
Active site ki shakal badal deta hai
Reversible: zyada substrate dalne se asar kam ho jata hai
Zyada substrate se asar khatam nahi hota; kitab inhein irreversible kehti hai
Misal: succinate dehydrogenase ke liye malonate
Misal: zehr (poisons), penicillin

blocks.prompt: d) Enzyme protein hai. pH badalne se us ka kaam kyun bigar jata hai? Protein ki banawat ke hawale se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: pH badalne se acidic aur basic side chains (–COOH/–COO⁻, –NH₂/–NH₃⁺) ke charges badal jate hain. Is se tertiary structure ko thaamne wale ionic aur hydrogen bonds toot jate hain, active site ki shakal badal jati hai aur substrate fit nahi hota (enzyme denature ho jata hai).

blocks.text: Cobra ke zehr mein PLA2 (phospholipase A2) enzyme hota hai jo khoon ke laal cell ki membrane (bahar wali patli jhilli) tor deta hai. Is se hemolysis (laal cells ka phatna) hota hai, affected organ (jis hisse par asar hua) soojh jata hai aur aakhir mein maut ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke PLA2 laal cell ki 'cell wall' torta hai. Khoon ke laal cell ki cell wall hoti hi nahi; PLA2 us ki membrane ke phospholipids ko torta hai.

items: Competitive (reversible) inhibitors substrate jaise hote hain: succinate ke liye malonate.
Non-competitive (irreversible) inhibitors active site ki shakal badalte hain; zehr aur penicillin.
Penicillin transpeptidase rok kar bacteria ki cell wall banne nahi deti.
